title: LLC annual-compliance penalties, per jurisdiction
description: DRAFT - the starting contract, expected to change while the pilot runs. Records the late-fee shape for an LLC's annual obligations, the grace period, and the reinstatement fee after administrative dissolution. Deliberately minimal: one flat amount or one monthly rate, no penalty matrices, no interest tables. This namespace is authoritative for these values.

lateFeeUsd.description: Flat late fee in USD. null when the state uses a rate or publishes none.

lateFeeRatePercentPerMonth.description: Monthly percentage or interest rate. The only rate field, by design: no interest tables, no compounding schedules.

lateFeeBasis.description: What the state actually publishes. mixed means more than one shape applies; the dominant figure goes in the fields and the rest in notes.

gracePeriodDays.description: Published grace before the late fee applies. null when none is published, which is not the same as zero.

reinstatementFeeUsd.description: The fee to reinstate after administrative dissolution, including any per-year component folded in; reinstatementNote says how.

reinstatementNote.description: One short sentence: what reinstatement requires, such as delinquent reports, per-year fees, or a time window.

notes.description: Anything the fields cannot carry without lying: the shape calls behind lateFeeBasis, excluded penalties, dissolution timelines.

needsReview.description: What is missing and what would settle it.

type.description: Source class, for deriving record confidence mechanically. null where none of the classes fits.

lastVerified.description: The date the cited pages were retrieved and every quoted passage was mechanically confirmed to occur in them.

quote.description: One contiguous verbatim passage, copied from the page as retrieved, artefacts included. Never assembled across an ellipsis, never taken from a search snippet, never tidied.

supports.description: Which value in the enclosing object this passage grounds, by field name (lateFeeUsd, gracePeriodDays, reinstatementFeeUsd, ...). A record carrying several passages is only honest if each one says what it is evidence for.
